info.title: Black Stone E-commerce API
info.description:
REST API for the Black Stone women fashion store (Hijab, Orna, Three-Piece).

### Response format
Every endpoint answers with the same envelope: `{ success, message, data }`, plus `meta` on paginated lists.
Errors use `{ success, message, errorSources }`.

### Authentication
Log in with `POST /api/auth/login` (customer) or `POST /api/auth/admin/login` (admin), then press **Authorize**
and paste the `accessToken`. Endpoints are labelled **Public**, **Customer** or **Admin** in their description.

### Business rules worth knowing
- Prices, discounts, delivery charges and totals are always recalculated server side; amounts sent by the client are ignored.
- Stock is validated and reserved atomically, so concurrent orders cannot oversell. Cancelling an order restores stock.
- Orders store product and variant snapshots, so historical orders stay correct when the catalog changes.
- Order status and payment status are separate state machines. Submitting a transaction ID never means a payment is verified.
- Cash on delivery orders require no transaction ID or screenshot; their payment is settled when the order is delivered.
- Only approved reviews are publicly visible.

get.description: **Customer.** Returns the cart with server calculated prices and totals. Lines that can no longer be ordered are returned with `isAvailable: false` and an `issue` message instead of failing the request. Guests keep their cart on the frontend and check out with an explicit `items` array.

delete.description: **Customer.** Removes every line from the cart.

post.summary: Add an item to the cart
post.description: **Customer.** Adds a product/variant line, or increases the quantity of an existing line. Validated on every write: the product must exist and be `active`, a variant must be selected when the product has variants, the variant must be active, the quantity must be a positive whole number (max 50 per line) and stock must be sufficient. Prices are never taken from the client - they are recalculated from the product data on every read.

400.description: Invalid payload, missing variant selection or more than 50 units requested.

example.message: Please select a variant for "Premium Jersey Hijab".

errorSources.message: Please select a variant for "Premium Jersey Hijab".

patch.description: **Customer.** Replaces the quantity of one line. Validated on every write: the product must exist and be `active`, a variant must be selected when the product has variants, the variant must be active, the quantity must be a positive whole number (max 50 per line) and stock must be sufficient. Prices are never taken from the client - they are recalculated from the product data on every read.

404.description: The item is not in the cart, or the product no longer exists.

delete.description: **Customer.** Removes one product/variant line from the cart.

404.description: The item is not in the cart.

post.description: **Public or Customer.** Recalculates the order summary before the customer confirms: item prices, discounts, the delivery charge for the selected area and the grand total. Send `source: "cart"` (logged-in) or an explicit `items` array (Buy Now / guest). Nothing sent by the client influences the amounts.

401.description: A cart checkout was requested without a customer token.

post.description: **Public or Customer.** Creates an order from the cart (`source: "cart"`), from an explicit item list (Buy Now) or as a guest without an account. Business rules: every price, discount, delivery charge and total is recalculated server side; stock is validated and reserved atomically so concurrent orders cannot oversell; product and variant snapshots are stored on the order. The order starts as `pending` with payment status `pending`, and the response contains the payment instructions for the chosen method. A cart based checkout clears the cart. Rate limited.

get.summary: Get payment instructions for an order
get.description: **Customer (own order) or Admin.** Returns the merchant number, account type, payable amount and step by step instructions for the order payment method.

patch.description: **Admin.** Allowed transitions: `pending → confirmed → processing → shipped → delivered`, plus `pending`, `confirmed` or `processing` → `cancelled`. Any other transition is rejected with 400. Cancelling restores the reserved stock. Marking a cash on delivery order as `delivered` also sets its payment status to `verified`; the payment status of wallet orders is never changed here.

200.description: Order status updated to confirmed successfully!

message.example: Order status updated to confirmed successfully!

400.description: Invalid status transition or the order is already in that status.

example.message: An order cannot go from "pending" to "shipped".

errorSources.message: An order cannot go from "pending" to "shipped".

patch.description: **Admin.** Internal note stored on the order. It is returned with the order for both admin and customer.

**Customer (own order) or Admin.** Customers may cancel only while the order is `pending` or `confirmed`; admins may also cancel a `processing` order. Shipped and delivered orders can never be cancelled. Reserved stock is returned to inventory. The payment status is not changed - use the refund endpoint for a verified payment.

400.description: The order is already cancelled or has progressed too far to be cancelled.

example.message: An order that is already shipped cannot be cancelled. Please contact support.

errorSources.message: An order that is already shipped cannot be cancelled. Please contact support.

get.summary: Get the payment of an order
get.description: **Customer (own order), Admin or guest.** Guests must pass the order phone number as the `phone` query parameter. The screenshot storage key is never returned.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Required for guest orders - must match the phone number used at checkout.

post.description: **Customer (own order), Admin or guest.** `multipart/form-data`. The customer sends the wallet transaction ID and optionally a screenshot (JPEG, PNG or WEBP, max 5MB). Business rules: only bKash and Nagad orders accept a submission - cash on delivery orders are rejected; transaction IDs must be unique across orders; a submission sets the payment status to `submitted`, which does **not** mean the payment is verified and does not change the order status; a rejected payment can be resubmitted; a verified payment cannot. Guests must include the order `phone` field. Rate limited.

200.description: Payment information submitted! Our team will verify it shortly.

message.example: Payment information submitted! Our team will verify it shortly.

example.message: Payment information submitted! Our team will verify it shortly.

400.description: Validation failed, the order is cash on delivery or cancelled, or the payment is already verified.

example.message: This order is a cash on delivery order - no transaction is required!

errorSources.message: This order is a cash on delivery order - no transaction is required!

403.description: Not the owner of the order, or a wrong phone number was supplied for a guest order.

409.description: This transaction ID has already been used for another order.

get.description: **Admin.** Payment verification queue. Filter with `status=submitted` to see everything waiting for manual verification.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches order number, transaction ID or sender number.

patch.description: **Admin.** Marks the payment as `verified` after the transaction has been checked against the merchant statement, and mirrors the status onto the order. The order status is not changed - update it separately. Only `pending` or `submitted` payments can be verified.

400.description: The payment cannot move to `verified` from its current status.

example.message: A payment cannot go from "verified" to "verified".

errorSources.message: A payment cannot go from "verified" to "verified".

patch.description: **Admin.** Marks a submitted payment as `rejected` and stores the reason, which is returned to the customer. The customer can then submit new payment details.

example.rejectionReason: Transaction ID not found in the merchant statement

patch.description: **Admin.** Only a `verified` payment can be refunded. This records the refund in the payment history; the money is transferred manually outside the system.

get.description: **Admin or the customer who owns the order.** Payment screenshots are stored outside the public upload directory and can only be read through this endpoint. Returns the raw image file.

404.description: No screenshot was submitted for this payment.

get.summary: List approved reviews of a product
get.description: **Public.** Only `approved` reviews are returned - pending and rejected reviews are never exposed publicly. The product rating aggregate (`ratingAverage`, `ratingCount`) is derived from these reviews.
**Customer.** Returns the reviews written by the authenticated customer, including pending and rejected ones.

post.description: **Customer.** Rating must be a whole number between 1 and 5. A customer can review a product only once. Reviews written by a customer with a delivered order for that product are flagged `isVerifiedPurchase`. Every review starts as `pending` and becomes public only after an admin approves it.

message.example: Review submitted successfully! It will be published once approved.

errorSources.message: You have already reviewed this product!

delete.description: **Customer (own review) or Admin.** The product rating aggregate is recalculated afterwards.

patch.description: **Admin.** Approves or rejects a review. Approving publishes it and recalculates the product `ratingAverage` and `ratingCount` from the approved reviews only.

get.description: **Admin.** Aggregated numbers for the admin home screen: orders by status, customers, products with low stock, pending reviews, payments awaiting verification, revenue (verified payments only, total and last 30 days), the five most recent orders and the ten lowest-stock products.
